added_callbacks.subtest: Registered image font dependencies without contextual colors: direct em and lh
added_callbacks.message: assert_equals: Computed registered image: {"mode":"direct em and lh","expression":"linear-gradient(red 1em, blue 1lh)","literalImage":"linear-gradient(red 1em, blue 1lh)","rows":[{"size":20,"height":40,"parentSize":12,"parentHeight":24,"first":"linear-gradient(rgb(255, 0, 0) 12px, rgb(0, 0, 255) 24px)","expected":"linear-gradient(rgb(255, 0, 0) 20px, rgb(0, 0, 255) 40px)","font":"20px","lineHeight":"40px","parentFont":"12px","parentLineHeight":"24px","attrActual":"40px","attrExpected":"40px"},{"size":32,"height":64,"parentSize":18,"parentHeight":36,"first":"linear-gradient(rgb(255, 0, 0) 18px, rgb(0, 0, 255) 36px)","expected":"linear-gradient(rgb(255, 0, 0) 32px, rgb(0, 0, 255) 64px)","font":"32px","lineHeight":"64px","parentFont":"18px","parentLineHeight":"36px","attrActual":"64px","attrExpected":"64px"}]} expected "linear-gradient(rgb(255, 0, 0) 20px, rgb(0, 0, 255) 40px)" but got "linear-gradient(rgb(255, 0, 0) 12px, rgb(0, 0, 255) 24px)"
